decisions.reason: Having remained on the market after its 2023 launch and drawing directly on the firm's core spraying capabilities, it is likely performing at least near aspiration levels and is worth retaining in a growing industry.

As an incremental pump close to the established offer, it is the type of product a medium-sized German machinery firm would normally keep while exploiting accumulated customer feedback and routine improvements.

Because this is a broader product line with several models built on existing competences, prior resource commitment and likely cross-customer applicability make withdrawal unlikely unless results clearly fall below aspiration.

Although still the most uncertain and somewhat more adjacent than the others, it supports the firm's move toward future-oriented system solutions, so available slack and ongoing market learning favor keeping it for now.

As a 2024 launch that is close to the firm's core two-component application business, management would usually allow more time for evaluation before reallocating resources unless early outcomes disappoint markedly.
